questionLanguage.rule: Rotate across approved question language entries for each CP.

explanationStyles.rule: Rotate across approved explanation entries applicable to each CP.

primeInputCoverage.rule: Prime input numbers must appear in audit reporting for applicable CPs.

compositeInputCoverage.rule: Composite input numbers must appear in audit reporting for applicable CPs.

primeBaseCoverage.rule: Prime base buckets should be represented over audit batches where applicable.

largestPrimeFactorCoverage.rule: Largest prime factor buckets must be represented in audit reporting.

smallestPrimeFactorCoverage.rule: Smallest prime factor buckets must be represented in audit reporting.

selectedPrimeCoverage.rule: Selected prime buckets must be represented in audit reporting.

selectedExponentCoverage.rule: Selected exponent buckets must be represented in audit reporting. Exponent 0 is excluded by the approved Option A policy.

primePowerCoverage.rule: Exponent 1 and repeated-prime cases must both be visible over audit batches.

numberShapeCoverage.rule: Small composite, medium composite, large composite, prime-heavy, repeated-prime, and mixed-prime shapes must be auditable.
